playbook.note: The fa playbooks file is largely untranslated; پلی‌بوک is the established Persian transliteration (as in Ansible playbooks). Plural: پلی‌بوک‌ها.

run.note: Noun (a run): اجرا, plural اجراها. Verb (run a playbook): اجرا کردن پلی‌بوک.

checklist.note: Common Persian usage; فهرست وارسی is a more formal alternative.

status update.note: Post update: ارسال به‌روزرسانی. Use the ZWNJ spelling به‌روزرسانی, not بروزرسانی.

retrospective.note: In agile contexts the transliteration رتروسپکتیو is also common; standardize on بازنگری.

follower.note: Follow/Unfollow: دنبال کردن / لغو دنبال کردن (core glossary).

trigger.note: Aligns with trigger word = کلمه محرک in the core glossary.

action.note: Run/Task/Channel Actions: اقدامات اجرا / اقدامات وظیفه / اقدامات کانال.

metric.note: Plural: شاخص‌ها; سنجه is a more literal alternative for 'metric'.

due date.note: Due (label): سررسید; No due date: بدون تاریخ سررسید.

timeline.note: One existing fa string uses the transliteration تایملاین; خط زمانی is the standard Persian term.

assignee.note: The person a task is assigned to; plain مسئول works where context is clear.

invitation.note: Here it is the automatic adding of members when a run starts; the email/link sense in the core glossary is دعوت‌نامه.

run channel.note: Create a run channel: ایجاد کانال اجرا.

broadcast.note: Broadcast update: پخش به‌روزرسانی در کانال‌های انتخاب‌شده.

attribute.note: Property fields: فیلدهای ویژگی; aligns with core glossary attribute = ویژگی.
